trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own. There is no separate task: it is the capstone of the whole list, so the roadmap below is the guide. Expect 200 to 300 hours if you chase everything at a relaxed pace.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Open the in-game 100% checklist once the story is done and work down it: story missions, stranger strands, activities, collectibles and the crime tallies. The checklist itself unlocks after the credits, and it is the only reliable way to see what is left. Do the missable meditation spots first, then the long grinds (250 stunts, 42 shooting range golds, 100 WAiNK scans).
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Finish the last story mission and the trophy pops with the credits. It cannot be missed: the story always ends the same way, and free roam stays open afterwards for cleanup.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Leonida holds 397 stunts in total: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps, and you need 250 of any mix. Under-bridge flights are the quickest to grind, and the game tracks your progress by region under Progress, then Activities, then Stunts. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past this trophy if you are chasing the platinum.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: There are 42 Shooting Range challenges across the ranges at Rodgers Ranch, Port Gellhorn, Griffin and Balsero, and every one needs a gold medal. Learn each range's target pattern, then run it until the gold time or score is yours; the range keeps your best result, so a single clean run is enough. Many guides call this the hardest trophy after 100% completion.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.guide: Eight bank vaults are scattered around Leonida and you need to rob five of them and get away clean each time. Plan the escape before you walk in: a fast car parked nearby and a route out of the wanted radius matter more than the robbery itself. Bring your partner for the duo trophies at the same time.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Eight stranger strands count: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret, plus two more that open as you explore. Each strand ends in its own trophy, so finishing all five named finals plus the rest earns this silver along the way. Check the map for the stranger markers after each story chapter, since new strands unlock as the story moves on.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.guide: There are 18 collectible card sets hidden around Leonida and you need to finish any three. Cards sit in shops, houses and odd corners, so pick up every set you pass rather than hunting one set at a time. The 100% checklist wants 15 sets, so this trophy is only the start of the card hunt.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.description: Scan 100 locations with the WAiNK app.
trophies.guide: Open the WAiNK app on your phone and scan landmarks, signs and oddities as you travel: 100 scanned locations earns the trophy. It pairs naturally with exploring every part of Leonida, so scan whatever the app highlights instead of making a separate trip for it.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Nine activity types are spread across Leonida: racing, fishing, the shooting range, drone races, arcade games, stunts, bowling, meditation and more. Try each one once and the trophy pops. It is an early-game trophy by design: sample everything as you meet it instead of saving activities for the end.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Fourteen Top Fun drone race spots are marked around the map. Win a race at each one: learn the gates on a practice run, then race clean. The drone handles the same everywhere, so the challenge is the course, not the vehicle.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races anywhere in Leonida: street, off-road, boat and air races all count, as long as each race is a different event. Work through the race markers on the map and the total climbs on its own.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Find Cal at a fishing spot and beat him at his own challenge. Watch the line tension and reel in bursts rather than holding the button down, and the fish comes in. Fishing is one of the nine activity types, so it also feeds Master of None.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Walk into any arcade in Leonida, pick a cabinet and play it to the end of a game. It does not matter which cabinet or whether you win: finishing one game is enough.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Meditate at every meditation spot in Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. This is the only trophy the guides flag as possibly missable: one spot sits at Jason's house and is tied to Chapter 1, so meditate there before the story moves past it. The other spots are open all game, so clear the Jason's house spot early and sweep the rest during exploration.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.guide: Eighty challenges are tracked in the game and you need 50 of them. They cover stunts, races, combat, exploration and more, so they complete themselves while you chase the other trophies. The 100% checklist wants 70, so keep an eye on the challenge list as the platinum approaches.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4-star Wanted level with your partner.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, raise a 4-star wanted level, then lose the heat together without either of you being caught. A fast car and a quiet corner of the map do the work: break line of sight, wait out the search, and the trophy pops when the stars clear.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner without losing your Wanted level.
trophies.guide: Rob three shops back to back with your partner, keeping a wanted level the whole time: if the heat drops, the chain breaks and you start over. Pick three shops close together, move fast between them, and keep the getaway car running.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Drive, ride or fly 100 different vehicles and each new one counts as discovered. Leonida is full of variety, so hop into anything you have not driven yet: the counter climbs fastest when you stop using the same car everywhere.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Trigger Combat Focus with at least five enemies in front of you and drop all five before it ends. Pick a busy fight, wait until the group is clustered, then activate it and work through them quickly.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without tripping the alarm or being spotted. Go in quiet, take what you need and leave before anyone reacts: a loud entry voids the attempt, so plan the approach and the exit first.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Stop an armored truck, take its cargo and escape the police response. Ram it off the road or block it, grab the cash, then lose the wanted level the same way you would after any robbery.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Visit every named part of Leonida, from Vice City to the swamps and the Keys. Drive the map edge to edge and the trophy pops when the last area registers. It pairs well with the WAiNK scans and the stunt hunt, so explore with a purpose rather than ticking boxes one by one.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation from each gang in Leonida. There are 39 gang operations in total, so you have plenty to choose from: hit a different gang's operation each time until every gang has been robbed once.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Launder $250,000 in marked bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Marked bills pile up from robberies and heists; launder $250,000 of them through your contacts over the course of the game. It is a slow total, not a single job, so keep laundering as you earn and it lands long before the platinum does.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across the shops of Leonida: clothes, weapons, food and everything else counts. It accumulates naturally over a full playthrough, and the garages for Little Boxes help push the total along.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all eight garage properties around Leonida, $160,000 in total. They give you somewhere to store the vehicles you discover for Whip It Good, so buy them as you find them rather than leaving them all for the end.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles on the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Open the Scooter Bros app and register ten vehicles you own or find. Any ten will do, so register the cars you drive most and the trophy pops quickly.
trophies.name: On the Spot

trophies.guide: Finish Gone Fishing, Jason's first mission, and the trophy pops. It is the first story trophy and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 1 to its end. Chapter trophies unlock automatically as the story moves on, so just keep playing.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 2 to its end. Chapter trophies unlock automatically as the story moves on, so just keep playing.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 3 to its end. Chapter trophies unlock automatically as the story moves on, so just keep playing.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 4 to its end. Chapter trophies unlock automatically as the story moves on, so just keep playing.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. Story mission trophies unlock as part of the plot and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. Story mission trophies unlock as part of the plot and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. Story mission trophies unlock as part of the plot and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. Story mission trophies unlock as part of the plot and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. Story mission trophies unlock as part of the plot and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. Story mission trophies unlock as part of the plot and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Follow Andy's stranger strand to its last mission, Puff Puff Pass, and finish it. Stranger strands open as the story progresses, so check Andy's marker on the map after each chapter.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.guide: Follow Kenton's stranger strand to its final mission and finish it. Stranger strands open as the story progresses, so check Kenton's marker on the map after each chapter.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.guide: Follow Billy's stranger strand to its final mission and finish it. Stranger strands open as the story progresses, so check Billy's marker on the map after each chapter.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.guide: Follow Randy's stranger strand to its final mission and finish it. Stranger strands open as the story progresses, so check Randy's marker on the map after each chapter.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.guide: Follow Tyrone's stranger strand to its final mission and finish it. Stranger strands open as the story progresses, so check Tyrone's marker on the map after each chapter.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret asks you to hunt a unique animal. Track it through its territory, take the shot when it presents itself, and bring the proof back to Bret. It is a hunting strand, not a combat one, so patience beats firepower.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure from VCIA (the airport).
trophies.guide: Steal a plane from Vice City International Airport and take off without a flight plan. Get to a runway, grab an aircraft and climb away from the airport before the response catches up with you.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.description: A secret involving a Rhino tank.
trophies.guide: A secret tied to a Rhino tank. The exact trigger is still unconfirmed in the published guides, so this one is honest about that: keep an eye on the guide pages as players pin it down, and try the tank-related spots around the military areas in the meantime.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Head to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and enjoy the view. It is a quiet moment trophy: go to the right spot on the beachfront, take the drink, and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom.
trophies.guide: Drive a car straight through a vehicle showroom's glass and out the other side. Pick a showroom with a clear run-up, build speed, and smash through: the trophy pops when you break out.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow through at Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go to the bowling alley at Kolt & Associates and follow through on a game. Bowl a full game there and the trophy pops: it is a place-and-activity trophy, not a score trophy.
trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. The published guides have not pinned down the exact trigger yet, so this guide says so plainly rather than inventing steps: watch the guide pages for confirmation as players work it out.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.description: Choices made, for better or worse.
trophies.guide: A story-choice trophy: it pops when you make a particular choice in the story. Play through the story and make the choices as they come; the trophy is tied to one of them, and the guides have not named which one yet.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The exact trigger is still unconfirmed in the published guides, so this guide does not invent one: it likely involves retrying something that failed once, and the guide pages will confirm it as players pin it down.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: What just happened? The published guides list this one as unconfirmed, with no agreed method yet. It reads like an easter-egg trophy, so expect a strange encounter somewhere in Leonida, and check the guide pages as players confirm the trigger.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl someone over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl someone over with a melee drive-by: strike a pedestrian with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle. Line up a slow pass, swing as you go by, and the trophy pops when the hit lands.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
